product.title: Guided Yosemite Hiking Excursion

description.text: Hit the trail with a certified Yosemite hiking guide on a small-group excursion tailored to current conditions. Routes may include Yosemite Valley meadows, waterfall viewpoints, or moderate valley loops with naturalist commentary on flora and geology.

highlights: Routes adapted to season and fitness level

start.description: Meet your guide at the designated Yosemite Valley trailhead meeting point.

end.description: Return to the trailhead meeting point after the hike.

product.itinerarySummary: Hit the trail with a certified Yosemite hiking guide on a small-group excursion tailored to current conditions.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Valley
itineraryItems.description: Guided hike through valley trails with views of granite walls and meadows.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Falls
itineraryItems.description: Approach Lower Yosemite Fall on a moderate valley trail segment.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
